title: Tactical map generation rules
description: Rules for generating a tactical map from the tactical map request (spec TAC-080, TAC-038). Biome → terrain and prefab tables come from STR-095; exit count and exits are specced; map types and stages follow TAC-086..TAC-093.
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design placeholders listed in the spec.

mapTypes.description: TAC-086: type → {size, builtShare, foliageShare}; draft open 80/0.06/0.15, woods 64/0.03/0.50, marsh 64/0.02/0.30, hills 64/0.03/0.25, mountain 48/0.02/0.20, town 72/0.07/0.14, city 96 (small 80)/0.16/0.10, plant 96/0.11/0.10, crossing 64/0.05/0.14, shore 64/0.03/0.15

zones.description: TAC-087 stage 1: neighbour blend depth (about 0.2 of map size) and noise

blendShare.description: band depth from each edge as a share of map size; design about 0.2

deepFromShoreTiles.description: water farther than this from the shore is deep (impassable); design 4

roads.description: TAC-087 stage 3: widths highway 5, road 3, track 2; fords, bridges, village streets, farm track

widths.description: road width in tiles by kind

buildings.description: TAC-088: floor-plan rules (room types and size ranges, apartment layouts, shop ground floors) and placement per map type

kinds.description: building kind → footprint and door rules

w.description: footprint width range in tiles [min, max]

h.description: footprint depth range in tiles [min, max]

interiorDoor.description: has interior walls with doors (never locked, TAC-084)

lockClass.description: lockedDoorShare key for its outer doors

byMapType.description: map type → building kinds to draw from; a kind listed twice is drawn twice as often

wallMaterial.description: TAC-085 edge material of outer walls

windowEvery.description: one window per this many wall tiles

placementAttempts.description: placement tries per map before placement stops

largeBuildingKinds.description: TAC-088: building kinds with a playable roof (apartment blocks, offices, schools, landmarks, large halls)

prefabs.description: fixed pieces and props; the prefab table per biome is named by STR-095

parcels.description: TAC-087 stage 5: shelterbelt grid and gaps, crop fields; tall-crop share (TAC-090, optional)

gapShare.description: share of tree lines with gaps; design about a third

groundFill.description: TAC-087 stage 6: WFC classes, adjacency rules, weights

classes.description: WFC terrain classes (design grass, brush, trees, mud, rock)

foliage.description: classes counted toward the foliage share

rockShare.description: target share of rock among filled tiles

mudShare.description: target share of mud among filled tiles

rockNeighbours.description: classes allowed next to rock (design grass, brush, trees, rock); mud is never next to rock

baseByTable.description: tactical terrain table → terrain ID of the base ground class

details.description: TAC-087 stage 7: trunks, wrecks, craters, potholes, scatter props, connection

connectPockets.description: connect every walkable pocket to the main area (footbridge or cleared gap)

deployment.description: TAC-087 stage 8: player and enemy zone sizes

playerDepthTiles.description: player zone depth from the approach edge

enemyDepthTiles.description: enemy zone depth (from the opposite edge, or radius around the objective)

landmarks.description: TAC-092 (optional): landmark kinds, roster sizes, per-map count

exits.description: TAC-038 / TAC-080: exit templates; id is reported back as battle_result soldiers[].exitId

params.description: condition parameters, e.g. boat turn, crossing price

validate.description: TAC-089: required and reported checks; draft attempts 6, shareTolerance 0.06
